page.title: User Management
page.description: Manage users, their roles and permissions.

forms.step1Description: Fill in the user's basic information.
forms.step2Description: Fill in the user's profile details.
forms.step3Description: Fill in the user's official details.
forms.step4Description: Upload profile uploads for the user.
forms.usernameDescription: Used to log into the platform.
forms.passwordDescription: Password used to log into the account.
forms.emailDescription: Email address associated with the account.
forms.isPrivateDescription: If enabled, the user's profile will be private and not visible to others.
forms.isPrivatePlaceholder: Select if the profile should be private
forms.deleteUserConfirmation: Are you sure you want to delete this user?
forms.requirePasswordCheckDescription: Users will be prompted to update their password on their next login.
forms.uploadsDescription: Drag and drop files here or click to upload. Supported formats: JPG, PNG. Max size: 5MB.

sheet.createUserDescription: Use this form to define a new user within the system. A user is identified by their unique email address, Fill in all required fields to ensure the user is successfully added.
sheet.updateUserDescription: Use this form to update an existing user within the system. A user is identified by their unique email address, Fill in all required fields to ensure the user is successfully updated.

dialogs.deleteUserDescription: This action is irreversible and permanent. Deleting the user will remove all associated roles and connections, affecting their access and permissions. Please proceed with caution.
dialogs.activateUserDescription: Activating a user will enable their account, allowing them to log in and access the platform.
dialogs.deactivateUserDescription: Deactivating a user will prevent them from logging in and accessing the platform, but their data will remain intact.
dialogs.approveUserDescription: Approving a user will grant them access to the platform and its features.
dialogs.disapproveUserDescription: Disapproving a user will revoke their access to the platform, but their data will remain intact.
